17:36 Local Time, 07:36 GMT, 13:06 IST: Australia holds a 101-run lead at the close of an eventful Day 1, finishing at 165/8 after a wild 18-wicket opening day. After winning the toss and electing to bowl, Australia's attack delivered a ruthless performance, rolling Bangladesh over for just 64. Mitchell Starc ignited the collapse by taking a wicket off the very first ball and went on to claim a stunning 6/12, completing his five-wicket haul inside the first 45 minutes of play. While Bangladesh's top order surrendered meekly to early seam and swing, brief resistance from the tail pushed them past 50 to avoid their lowest-ever Test total.

Though Australia expected a smooth response, Bangladesh fought back brilliantly with the ball. Shoriful Islam spearheaded the fightback, exploiting persistent movement off the pitch to capture a superb six-wicket haul. Most of the Australian lineup struggled to settle, but Steve Smith offered steady support before Cameron Green took control. Green anchored the innings with a fine half-century, combining with the lower order to push Australia's lead past 100. With a solid advantage in hand, Australia are in a strong position heading into Day 2. Do join us tomorrow and hope you have enjoyed our coverage. Until then it's goodbye from all of us here...

09:30 Local Time, 23:30 GMT, 05:00 IST: Welcome back to Day 2 of this action packed Test match in Mackay, where Australia look to build on their commanding position after an incredible 18-wicket opening day! Day 1 was pure drama from the start. Mitchell Starc set the tone by taking a wicket off the very first ball, storming to a five-wicket haul inside 45 minutes as Bangladesh collapsed to just 64 all out. However, Bangladesh fought back valiantly with the ball, led by a sensational six-wicket haul from Shoriful Islam that tore through Australia's top order.

At 148 for 8, Australia found themselves under pressure, but a classy, unbeaten half-century from Cameron Green alongside steady support from Nathan Lyon helped push the lead past 100 runs. Today, Green and Lyon will aim to add precious lower order runs and extend this lead as far as possible, while Bangladesh’s bowlers will be desperate to wrap up the tail quickly and get back out to bat with much greater discipline. The pitch is still offering assistance, so grab your coffee, we are in for another thrilling session of Test cricket!
